text: Given valid Gorelo credentials and no filters, when gorelo_list_tickets is called, then it returns up to limit (default 50, max 200) tickets with the required fields and the {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count} envelope.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_api_client.py::test_list_tickets_no_filters_returns_envelope -> PASSED (2026-11-02, dev/PRD-21211@33f0ad9)

text: Given gorelo_list_tickets(status_names="NoSuchStatus"), when the name does not resolve against gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, then it returns invalid_argument naming the known status values, without calling the Gorelo tickets endpoint.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_tickets_unknown_status_name_errors_without_calling_tickets_endpoint -> PASSED; asserts invalid_argument naming New/In Progress and zero calls to GET v1/tickets

text: Given gorelo_list_tickets(priority_names="urgent,bogus"), when one name is not one of the five fixed priority levels, then it returns invalid_argument naming the five valid priority names.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_tickets_unknown_priority_name_names_the_five_values -> PASSED; asserts all 5 priority names present in the message

text: Given a valid ticket id, when gorelo_get_ticket is called, then it returns the full ticket record (title, description, status, priority, type, source, client/contact/location, assignees, tags, linked assets, timestamps).
evidence: pytest ...::test_get_ticket_unwraps_data -> PASSED

text: Given an unknown id, when gorelo_get_ticket, gorelo_get_client, gorelo_get_contact, gorelo_get_contract, or gorelo_get_agent_asset is called, then each returns a not_found error envelope, never an uncaught exception.
evidence: pytest ...::test_get_unknown_id_returns_not_found (5 parametrized cases: ticket/client/contact/contract/agent_asset) -> 5 PASSED

text: Given a valid ticket id and a comment body with no conversation_id, when gorelo_add_ticket_comment is called, then the comment is posted to the ticket's Public conversation and the tool returns the created comment's id.
evidence: pytest ...::test_add_comment_defaults_to_public -> PASSED; asserts ConversationTypeId=1, no ConversationId sent, id returned

text: Given a valid ticket id, a comment body, and a conversation_id from a prior side-conversation, when gorelo_add_ticket_comment is called, then the comment is posted into that conversation instead of the main thread.
evidence: pytest ...::test_add_comment_with_conversation_id_targets_side_conversation -> PASSED

text: Given title, client_id, status_name_or_id, type_name_or_id, and group_id, when gorelo_create_ticket is called, then a ticket is created and the tool returns its id and display number.
evidence: pytest ...::test_create_ticket_required_fields -> PASSED; asserts POST body and {id, display_number} result

text: Given gorelo_create_ticket is called missing title, status, type, or group_id (each tried separately), then it returns invalid_argument naming the missing field, without calling the Gorelo create-ticket endpoint.
evidence: pytest ...::test_create_ticket_missing_required_field_errors_without_calling_gorelo -> PASSED (5 required fields each tried missing); zero POST calls

text: Given no filters, when gorelo_list_clients, gorelo_list_contacts, and gorelo_list_contracts are each called, then each returns up to limit records with the {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count} envelope.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_clients_contacts_contracts_no_filters -> PASSED

text: Given gorelo_list_clients(query="<a unique client name>"), when there is exactly one matching client, then only that client is returned.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_clients_query_filters -> PASSED; asserts Query param forwarded

text: Given gorelo_list_time_entries(ticket_ids="<id>"), when there are time entries logged against other tickets too, then only entries logged against the given ticket are returned, paged the same way as AC1.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_time_entries_filtered_by_ticket -> PASSED

text: Given no filters, when gorelo_list_agent_assets is called, then it returns up to limit devices with the required fields; given a valid agent_asset_id, gorelo_get_agent_asset returns the full device record.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_and_get_agent_assets -> PASSED

text: Given a request to /mcp missing X-Gorelo-Api-Key and/or X-Gorelo-Region, when any tool is called, then the response is 401 naming the missing header(s), for every tool in the Tools table.
evidence: pytest ...::test_missing_headers_return_401 -> 4 PASSED (parametrized); also confirmed live over HTTP: curl POST /mcp with no headers -> 401 (2026-11-02, local server on :8099)

text: Given Gorelo returns HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429, or a 5xx/network error (one case per status), when any tool call hits that response, then the error envelope carries the correct code/retryable per the mapping table, with Gorelo's own Message and 6-digit Code preserved in the message text.
evidence: pytest ...::test_error_envelope -> 8 PASSED (400/401/403/404/409/429/5xx/network mapped to the table)

text: Given Gorelo responds with HTTP 200, IsSuccess: false, and a non-empty Notifications array, when a tool parses that response, then it is treated as an error using the same mapping table, not as a successful empty result.
evidence: pytest ...::test_is_success_false_on_200_is_an_error -> PASSED

text: Given the server is running, when tools/list is called, then it returns exactly the 17 tools in the Data & API contract table, each with a description <=500 chars (first line <=100 chars) and the correct readOnlyHint/destructiveHint.
evidence: pytest tests/test_tools.py -> 60 PASSED; also confirmed live: curl tools/list over HTTP with placeholder creds returns all 17 tools (2026-11-02, local server on :8099)

text: Given a list tool (gorelo_list_tickets / _clients / _contacts / _contracts / _time_entries / _agent_assets) returns has_more: true and a next_cursor, when the same tool is called again with cursor=<next_cursor>, then it returns the next page of records, not a repeat of the first page.
evidence: pytest ...::test_list_tickets_cursor_round_trip -> PASSED; page 2 request carries Cursor=page-2-token from page 1's next_cursor

text: Given two interleaved fake requests carrying different X-Gorelo-Api-Key/X-Gorelo-Region values, when both are processed concurrently, then neither request's outgoing Gorelo call ever carries the other request's credentials or base host.
evidence: pytest ...::test_concurrent_requests_do_not_share_credentials -> PASSED

text: Given a real Gorelo trial/sandbox account, when initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call is run for gorelo_list_tickets and gorelo_create_ticket, then both succeed end-to-end and the field names returned match what this design assumed from the fetched OpenAPI schema.
steps: Obtain a real Gorelo API key and region for a trial/sandbox service provider (Settings -> Integrations -> Generate New Key)
Start the server locally with that key/region in X-Gorelo-Api-Key / X-Gorelo-Region
Call initialize, then tools/list, confirm all 17 tools are listed
Call gorelo_list_tickets with no filters; inspect the returned fields against the Data & API contract table
Call gorelo_create_ticket with a minimal valid payload; confirm a ticket is created in the Gorelo UI and the tool's returned id/display number match it
expect: tools/list lists all 17 tools; gorelo_list_tickets returns a 200-shaped {items,...} result with the documented fields present and correctly typed; gorelo_create_ticket creates a real ticket visible in the Gorelo web UI with the same title/client, and returns that ticket's real id and display number.
notes: Not required before shipping (no test account is not a blocker per vendor-mcp-development SOP 'no vendor test account is not a blocker'). Partial evidence collected instead: live tools/call against the real Gorelo API (api.usw.gorelo.io) with a placeholder X-Gorelo-Api-Key returned a clean {"error":{"code":"unauthorized",...}} envelope end-to-end (2026-11-02), proving the real network path, region host and error mapping work; the real-account field-name verification itself remains outstanding. Closes the 'schema drift' risk noted in Risks & dependencies only partially.
